text: Yes. Your agents work on the cloud computer, not on your own, so routines run on schedule while your Mac or PC is asleep or closed. The computer sleeps when nobody uses it and wakes when there's work.

head: What does an agent remember?

Simeon works best when each agent has one clear job. There are two ways to build a team around your work: add a ready-made team of five from the Marketplace, or ask Simeon to hire for one job at a time. This page covers both, with first tasks for the jobs people hand off most, and how to write a request an agent can finish.

head: Add a ready-made team
text: Each team in the Marketplace has five agents for one kind of work, already named, each with a face, a job, instructions and the three apps it asks to connect. Adding a team is free. 1. Open the Marketplace and choose a team. 2. Choose Add to Simeon . The Simeon app opens and shows the team: each agent, what it does and the apps it uses. 3. Choose Add to Simeon in the app. {c= 89acbc ar=7/5} The five agents appear together in your list of chats, in a folder named after the team, such as Founder Team , and the first one's chat opens. Each agent sends you a first message right away: it names the

head: Hire for one job at a time
text: If no team fits, tell Simeon what's taking up your time, in a sentence. He hires an agent for it and briefs it. See Hire an agent through Simeon. I run a small design studio. I lose hours every week to client emails, invoices and booking calls. Who should I hire first? Simeon recommends a first hire and says why. For a project, he proposes a small team, up to three agents to start.

head: First tasks to try
text: Each of these is a first message for an agent with that job. Change the details to fit your work. The apps after each heading are the ones the agent would ask you to connect.

head: Inbox (Gmail or Outlook)
text: Every morning at 8, sort my inbox. Draft replies to anything that only needs a yes or a date, file receipts and newsletters, and send me a summary of what needs me. {c= af8fa0 ar=16/11} Each reply comes as a draft card in the agent's chat. Read it, edit it if you like, and choose Send email . An agent sends an email without a card only when you've asked it, in the chat, to send that message to those people.

head: Finance (QuickBooks, Stripe or Xero)
text: Match October's Stripe payouts against our invoices in QuickBooks, chase any invoice more than 14 days late with a friendly reminder, and tell me where the money went.

head: Travel
text: Find me a flight from Seattle to LA tomorrow. The agent answers with a card of up to four flights, its pick in one line, and a panel for each flight with the times, the stops, the bags and the refund terms. {c= a5835f ar=4/3} Choose a flight to see its details, then Book with Simeon to book it. You fill in the traveller's details in a form, and nothing is paid until you allow the checkout.

head: Calendar (Google Calendar or Outlook)
text: Keep my mornings free for deep work. Move internal meetings to the afternoon, and send me a one-page brief before every call with someone outside the company.

head: Social media (Instagram, LinkedIn, Canva)
text: Turn what we shipped this week into three posts for Instagram and LinkedIn. Show me the drafts, and schedule the ones I approve for when our followers are online.

head: Research
text: Find the ten companies most likely to need what we sell, with the right person to contact at each and one line on why. Put it in a Google Sheet.

head: Sales (HubSpot or Salesforce)
text: After each sales call, update the deal in HubSpot, log the next step, and draft the follow-up email for me to send.

head: Hiring
text: Screen the new applicants for the designer role against the job description, and book a 30-minute call with the three best in my free slots next week.

head: Write a request an agent can finish
text: Say For example --- --- What you want done Chase every invoice more than 14 days late. Where the work is In QuickBooks and my Gmail. What you want back A list of who you chased and how much is still out. Where to stop Show me each reminder before it goes out. When to do it again Every Monday at 9. Correct the first results the way you would a new colleague, and ask the agent to remember how you like it done. Once a task comes back right, ask for it on a schedule and it becomes a routine.

head: Should I add a whole team or start with one agent?
text: Start with what takes the most of your time. If a team in the Marketplace matches your work, adding it gives you five agents briefed for it at once. If you only need one or two jobs done, hire through Simeon instead; you can add more agents at any time.

head: Can I add the same team twice?
text: No. If the team's agents are still in your list, the app shows Open with the team's folder name instead of Add to Simeon , and opens them.

head: Do the agents in a team work together?
text: Yes. Agents message each other to hand work on, and Simeon passes work to whichever agent's job it is. See How agents work together.

head: What if an agent needs an app I don't use?
text: Tell it which app you use instead, or that you'd rather it work in the website. Change its description so it remembers.

head: What is Simeon?
text: A team of AI agents for your business. Each agent has a job you give it, a computer of its own in the cloud, and access to the apps you connect. You ask in plain words, and they do the work. See Create and manage agents.

head: Do I need to set anything up?
text: No. There are no workflows to build. Tell an agent what you need. When it needs one of your apps, it asks you to sign in once, on that app's own page.

head: What do I need to use it?
text: A Mac with Apple silicon on macOS 15 or later, a PC with Windows 10 or 11, or an iPhone on iOS 26 or later. The same account works on all of them. See Get started and Simeon on iPhone.

head: How many agents can I have?
text: Up to 50, on every plan. Your plan sets how much they can do each week, not how many there are.

head: Where does the work happen?
text: On each agent's own desktop on your team's cloud computer, with a browser and files. You can watch it work or take control at any time. Routines keep running while your Mac is closed. See The agent's computer.

head: Can my agents use apps that don't have a connector?
text: Yes. They can use most websites in their browser, signed in as you. A connector is faster and more reliable when there is one. See Connect apps.

head: Can I talk to an agent?
text: Yes. Call any agent from its chat and talk it through out loud. See Message and call your agents.

head: Can my agents work with Claude Code, Codex or ChatGPT?
text: Yes. Connect them in External Agents and they join your Simeon Network: they can ask your Simeon agents for work, and your agents can ask them. See Simeon Network.

head: Will an agent act without asking?
text: Not on what matters. An email or a Slack message in your name comes as a draft you send yourself, and a purchase waits on a checkout card until you choose Allow . See Approvals, security, and privacy.

head: Can an agent spend my money?
text: Only through Link or Shop Pay, once you've added one in Settings › Wallet , and only after you allow the checkout card, confirmed with Face ID or Touch ID. Each Link purchase uses a one-time card, and the agent never sees a card number.

head: Do agents see my passwords?
text: A password you type in an agent's sign-in form goes straight into the page, and the agent doesn't see it. Logins you save in the Credentials Store are there for your agents to use. See Credentials Store and secure sign-in.

head: Is my data used to train AI?
text: No. We never use your content to train AI models, and the AI providers we use work under terms that don't let them train on it. Your data is encrypted in transit and kept apart from every other customer's. See the Privacy Policy.

head: How much does Simeon cost?
text: Standard is $30 a month, Pro $100 (3.5 times Standard's usage) and Max $200 (9 times). Every plan has every feature; they differ in how much your agents can do each week. See Plans and billing.

head: Is there a free trial?
text: Yes, 7 days with one week of Standard credits. On iPhone it starts when you first sign in, with no card. On the web and the Mac it starts with a card, and becomes your plan when the 7 days end unless you cancel it.

head: What happens when my credits run out?
text: Your agents wait until your week resets. To keep going sooner, upgrade your plan or buy extra credits: $10 for 3,000,000 credits, valid for 12 months.

head: Can I use my own ChatGPT or Claude plan?
text: Yes. Connect it in Settings › AI Models and choose its model. Your agents' work on it uses no Simeon credits; you still need a Simeon plan for their computers.

head: How do I cancel?
text: For a plan bought on the web or the Mac, choose Manage Billing in Settings › Usage & Billing and cancel on Stripe's page. For a plan bought on iPhone, open the iPhone's Settings › your name › Subscriptions .

head: How do I delete my account?
text: In the Simeon app on your Mac, Windows PC or iPhone, open Settings and choose Delete Account . Your agents, their computers and files, your chats, memory and routines are deleted, your apps disconnected and your subscription ended. It can't be undone. A plan billed through Apple isn't cancelled by this: cancel it in the iPhone's Settings › your name › Subscriptions .

head: Something isn't working
text: Quit and reopen the app first. If that doesn't fix it, choose Report an issue in the account menu, or contact us and tell us what you were doing.
